name: keeb-configurator
description: Web UI configurator for the keeb split keyboard (ZMK). Talks the KEEB TLV protocol; state mirrors the firmware's models.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run smoke
scripts.smoke: vite build --ssr scripts/ssr-smoke.ts --outDir dist-ssr --logLevel warn && node dist-ssr/ssr-smoke.js
